messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high error rate detected for /v1/generate (hosted). Escalation level: P1. Auto-opened incident INC-2026-324.

alice_ops: seeing a spike from the canary rollout that started ~5m ago. 5xxs on the text-gen path primarily.

bob_oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs now. which artifact rolled?

carla_engineer: rollout: model-service:v2.3.1 -> variant with weights hash 0x7f9a3b (from promoted bundle). Tokenizer bundle v1.12 was included. Canary target: 1%.

bob_oncall: thanks. initial metric: canary 1% has 35% 5xx, production 0.5% but rising. traffic shift paused.

dave_prod: customer reports of garbled completions for a small subset of inputs, likely tokenizer mismatch. examples posted in #support-ticket-2332.

emma_se: @bob_oncall customer impact: 12 enterprise customers, some requests returning "�" chars and truncated responses. Not widespread yet but escalated.

bob_oncall: ok putting kill-switch on rollout. flipping feature flag rollout_model_v2 -> OFF now.

carla_engineer: i ran a quick diff: model weights look consistent, but tokenizer vocab checksum mismatches: expected sha256: a1b2...c3 vs deployed d4e5...f6. That explains the mojibake.

alice_ops: is this a packaging error from the artifact build pipeline or a promotion mistake?

carla_engineer: likely promotion. build metadata shows tokenizer v1.12 tagged but artifact points to v1.10. suspect CI tag race.

bob_oncall: incident action plan: 1) stop canary (flag off) - done. 2) rollback canary hosts to model-service:v2.3.0 pinned. 3) invalidate tokenizer cache on edge. 4) verify customer sample set.

alice_ops: starting rollback job: runbooks/deploys#rollback-canary command queued.

carla_engineer: rollback command:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service model-service --target-revision v2.3.0 --scope canary
```

bob_oncall: running invalidate command on cache nodes:
```
redwoodctl cache invalidate --prefix kv:tokenizer:vocab --region us-west-2
```

alice_ops: rollback completed for canary pool. monitoring...

bob_oncall: 5xx rate on canary dropped to baseline within 90s. truncation reports decreased.

emma_se: pinging affected customers with interim note: we rolled back a canary update, investigating root cause, ETA for full restore TBD.

carla_engineer: root cause shortlist: token bundle mismatch due to tag race in artifact promotion. Remediation: pin tokenizer SHA in release manifest and add a pre-promote checksum gate in CI.

dave_prod: agreed. add rollout precheck that verifies tokenizer and weights checksums match manifest.

bob_oncall: creating follow-up tasks: INC-2026-324-T1 add checksum gate, T2 backfill monitoring for tokenization errors, T3 postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-324 status -> mitigated. Pager silenced by @bob_oncall.

alice_ops: handoff to daytime oncall @carla_engineer for postmortem writeup.

carla_engineer: will own postmortem, starting notes in docs/incidents/INC-2026-324.md. tagging infra and ci teams for remediation.

emma_se: communication draft posted to #customer-comms, please review before send.

bob_oncall: closing loop: no ongoing customer errors in last 10m, rollback successful, root cause plausible, next steps assigned. good work team :thumbsup:.
